# slackcli — Slack CLI for AI agents

> slackcli is a single-binary Slack CLI built for AI agents. It reads messages, threads, channel history, unreads and canvases, searches messages and files, downloads attachments to local paths, and sends, schedules, edits and reacts — printing compact, pruned JSON. Credentials are picked up from Slack Desktop (or Chrome, Brave, Firefox) with no setup, several workspaces are supported, and a safe mode keeps a human in the loop for anything that posts.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/maelvls/slackcli/blob/main/README.md): Installation, authentication, command map, safe mode, environment variables, file locations, exit codes
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/maelvls/slackcli/blob/main/skills/slackcli/SKILL.md): How an agent should use slackcli: safety rules, workflow, non-obvious behaviour
- [Agent references](https://github.com/maelvls/slackcli/blob/main/skills/slackcli/references/): Target selection (URL, channel, user) and JSON output and download behaviour
- `slackcli --help` and `slackcli <command> --help`: the authoritative reference for commands, flags and output

## Key features

- Read Slack messages, threads and channel history from a message URL, a channel name or a channel ID
- Search messages and files through Slack's search API, or by scanning given channels (`--channel`), with user, date and content-type filters
- Download attached files (snippets, images, canvases as Markdown) to absolute local paths
- Send, schedule, edit and delete messages, upload files with `message send --attach`, post Block Kit with `--blocks`, add and remove reactions
- Human-in-the-loop: `message compose` opens an editor in the user's browser where a person sends; `message draft` creates Slack-native drafts in the user's Slack client; `--safe-mode` / `SLACKCLI_SAFE_MODE=1` enforces review
- Inbox and saved items: `unreads`, `later`
- Channels and users: list conversations, create channels, invite members and Slack Connect guests, mark as read, look up users, open DMs
- Canvases: create and edit from Markdown, export to Markdown
- Workflows: list, inspect and run link-trigger workflows
- Zero-config auth from Slack Desktop on macOS, Linux and Windows, with browser fallbacks; standard `xoxb-`/`xoxp-` tokens via `SLACK_TOKEN`
- Self-update with checksum verification: `slackcli update`
